ld.description: Taps and swipes on an animation or a game never zoom or pan the page.

leadHtml:
TOUCH V0.27.0 BETA

@fzlt/core/touch

Taps and swipes on an animation or a game never zoom or pan the page. One delegated listener set on the document (capture, not passive) cancels, on the surfaces that match sel, what CSS touch-action can't: iOS Safari's gesturestart / gesturechange (its pinch, which ignores user-scalable=no) and any multi-touch touchstart / touchmove (a pinch anywhere else). One finger is never touched, so taps, drags and the page's own scroll stay. The CSS half lives in the Board UI kit (board-ui.css): touch-action: manipulation on the page (no double-tap zoom) and touch-action: none / pan-y plus overscroll-behavior: none on the same surfaces. Pass null to lock the whole page (a full-screen board; content pages keep pinch-zoom for WCAG 1.4.4). Returns release(): the page gets its gestures back.

rest.html:
IN SHORT
lockTouch(); // pinch never zooms the page from a slot, a game or the pad
lockTouch(document, null); // a full-screen board: the whole page
